text:
neha: quick sync - QA ran an fp8/int8 sweep against the customer summarizer endpoint and observed ~4.6% ROUGE-L degradation for long-context inputs (>=8k).

jordan: ouch. what exact precision stack? any fallbacks enabled?

neha: baseline fp16 -> fp8 (activation-only aggressive). KV-cache on. fallback path is int8 for attention matmuls.

liam: failure modes? hallucination vs truncation?

neha: mainly omissions and factual drift in bullet/list-heavy docs; short prompts looked fine. correlated with prefix length and numeric tables.

anna: can QA reproduce locally? same seeds/dataset?

neha: yes, reproducible on 10k-sample sweep with 3 seeds. sample log: ```ERROR: deg_score>threshold step=4823 sample=usr_8932 model=fp8-aggr-v3 metrics: rouge_l:-0.046 ppl:+0.3```

jordan: suggestion: telemetry-driven auto-gate that watches short-term degradation and flips route to int8 fallback if sustained. keep per-customer grace budgets.

liam: we have per-route config but no auto-gate. propose simple algo for ops to implement?

neha: sketch: deg_score = weighted(rouge_drop, factuality_loss, ppl_delta, cost_penalty). compute on 1h sliding windows. if deg_score > 0.03 for 3 consecutive windows -> flip to int8-fallback for T=30m and log incident.

anna: need exported examples that triggered the gate for triage. capture worst-10 diffs + link to eval run. ops-bot posts to #incidents.

jordan: agree. add consumer telemetry opt-out and audit log with signed rationale for compliance/private deployments.

liam: pseudo-config proposal for ops: ```precision_gate: window:3600 metrics:[rouge_l_drop,factuality,ppl_delta] threshold:0.03 consecutive_windows:3 fallback:int8-safe sample_export:10 cooldown:1800```

neha: two constraints: 1) only auto-gate for non-critical enterprise customers (SLO_flag=false); 2) manual approval required for Private deployments.

jordan: also include cost in deg_score with small weight (gamma=0.1) so we avoid flips for low ROI endpoints.

dev-bot: deploy check OK. helper commands: `rictl precision-gate status --route summarizer-v2` and `rictl precision-gate flip --route summarizer-v2 --to int8-safe --reason "deg_score 0.045"` :white_check_mark:

neha: action items: liam -> draft gate code + config schema; anna -> synthetic long-ctx tests; jordan -> eval export + sample UI; ops -> alert + runbook.

jordan: I'll write a short RFC with math, examples, and alert thresholds. ping when you have shadow deploy. :eyes:

liam: aiming for shadow deploy next Tue.

neha: thanks, keep gate conservative and observable. :thumbsup:
